result.journal: International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning and Artificial Intelligence for Education (iJET-AIE)
result.keywords: This study combines bibliometric and meta-analytic approaches to examine research trends in augmented reality and artificial intelligence in education across a selected corpus of papers published between 2012 and 2020. A total of 512 publications were reviewed using indicators such as publication year, authorship patterns, country of origin, research area, methodology, learner group, sample size, data collection technique, bibliography depth, and citation impact. Results suggest that the intersection of immersive technologies and intelligent learning systems has been increasingly applied in higher education, teacher training, STEM learning, and special education, with growing international collaboration and a focus on student engagement, adaptive learning, and visualization-based instruction.
result.title: A Bibliometric Meta-Analysis of Augmented Reality and Artificial Intelligence in Education Research from 2012-2020
